recipe.criteria: Tall kneeling reverse Nordic: trunk and thighs tilt backward together through illustrative 35-degree range; 3.5-second lean, 1-second hold, 3.5-second return. Knees and lower legs remain supported; no ankle restraint.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
